name: Ion Electronic Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Ion Electronic Materials Co., Ltd., headquartered in Hsinchu County, Taiwan, specializes in supplying advanced materials to the domestic semiconductor and optoelectronic manufacturing industries. The company's product portfolio includes various specialized gases for applications such as ion implantation, electronic cleaning, laser processes, and electron deposition. Additionally, it offers comprehensive logistics solutions for the secure storage and transportation of hazardous goods. Established in 2016, Ion Electronic Materials also boasts an international presence, exporting its offerings to markets like Japan, Singapore, South Korea, and other global destinations.
